articleTitle: FPGA-based memory test system design and test algorithm implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article introduces the characteristics of FPGA board-level test systems and outlines some common memory fault models and memory test algorithms. The memory test system is constructed by utilizing the FPGA chip of Xilinx Company, which has the advantages of low cost, high flexibility and configurability compared with the traditional ATE machine test, making the memory test more convenient and faster. This system consists of FPGA control board and test board to form the test system, using Verilog language to develop the hardware system, making read/write control module to realize the memory function test. Three basic test algorithm modules, namely, MSCAN, Checkerboard and March, are also completed. Finally, the 23K256 SRAM from Microchip Company is used as the chip to be tested to verify the system, and the memory read/write function test and graphic algorithm test are successfully experimented, and the function test passes, which verifies the function of the test system.

articleTitle: Data aggregation method for privacy protection in federated learning environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the development and application of computer federated learning technology, there are more attack methods targeting federated learning, posing challenges to data privacy security. This article proposes a weight hiding federated learning secure aggregation method to address the risk of inference attacks caused by leaked aggregation weights during the federated learning aggregation process. This method prevents attackers or malicious servers from obtaining information such as aggregation weights, and utilizes Bayesian differential privacy to reduce noise disturbance to the model. Experiments have shown that this method can effectively prevent attackers from implementing inference attacks through malicious tampering with aggregated weights, and significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of federated learning algorithms.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-Swin: Urban road trash detection based on improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of human awareness of environmental protection, various policies and measures for garbage classification have been put into practice. The management of road waste is crucial for maintaining the overall appearance of a city. While trash detection algorithms have been primarily focused on beach, domestic, and rural waste in the past, urban roads have received less attention due to their complex and diverse nature. Consequently, the existing algorithms for trash detection on urban roads are limited and have a low detection rate. To address this issue, this study proposes a deep learning-based urban road trash detection model called YOLOv7-Swin. This model utilizes the YOLOv7 model as the baseline and incorporates the Swin Transformer to improve feature extraction through the Attention mechanism. Additionally, a dataset named Road-Trash has been created, which consists of urban road trash samples from various road environments. This dataset serves as a target detection benchmark for urban road trash. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model exhibits an average accuracy mAP0.5 increase of 3% compared to the baseline model. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of the YOLOv7-Swin model in identifying and classifying different types of road trash on urban roads.

articleTitle: A new SPICE modeling approach of annular MOSFET in 350 nm commercial CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Annular gate MOSFETs have emerged as potential solutions for radiation-hardened electronics, demonstrating exceptional total ionizing dose tolerance. However, accurate modeling of annular MOSFETs is crucial when designing analog integrated circuits for use in radiation environments, especially when implementing commercial CMOS processes. To enable circuit simulation using tools like SPECTRE/SPICE, foundry-provided PDKs must incorporate a rigorously verified compact model of annular MOSFET behavior. TCAD simulation can then be used to numerically evaluate the current characteristics of the annular MOSFET against the refined compact model constructed from the foundry-provided PDK. In this paper, by aligning the current characteristics of a standard NMOS between TCAD and SPICE simulations, we can verify the material process conditions. Then, based on the material process parameters, the model of the annular gate MOSFET is established using the TCAD simulator. articleTitle: Infusion Prior Information Prismatic Generative Adversarial Learning Network for Multi-material Decomposition in Dual-bin Photon Counting Computed Tomography
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Spectral computed tomography based on photon-counting detector (PCCT) is a promising technique with high spatial and energy resolution. Multi-material decomposition is a typical application of PCCT, which can provide accurate material identification. However, due to the finite photons in each energy bin, the number of energy bins cannot grow without limit while the image quality suffers from serious noise. Despite the quantitative capability for multi-material, existing methods require adequate energy bins corresponding to the number of materials. In this paper, an infusion prior information prismatic generative adversarial learning network is proposed based on generative adversarial learning for multi-material decomposition in dual-bin PCCT. First, to alleviate the pathological nature, prior images corresponding to full spectrum is introduced into the solution. Second, generative adversarial leaning is utilized to characterization the material with its nonlinear calculation capability. Thirdly, the idea of interactive structure is draw for multi-material decomposition task. Numerical experiments based on structured fibro-glandular tissue data were carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results demonstrate its accuracy on material quantification over other methods in this field under the condition of finite energy bins.

articleTitle: Consensus of Multiple UGVs System Based on Multiplayer Game under DoS Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article investigates the consensus of Multiple Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) System based on game modeling under external intermittent random Deny of Service (DoS) attacks. Considering the increasing complexity of DoS attacks against communication networks of Multiple UGVs System in open environments, the communication topology results multiple switching modes. Under the framework of Game theory, the consensus of Multiple UGVs System under DoS attack is transformed into the Nash equilibrium solution of multiplayer game. Finally, simulation results of a numerical examples are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A CEEMDAN-QPSO-BiLSTM Based Hybrid Model for Water Quality Parameter Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Water contamination is a major concern worldwide due to its impact on the global ecology. Accurate forecasting of water quality parameters is crucial for effective water contamination control. However, existing models face challenges in accurately predicting water quality series due to their nonlinearity and non-stationarity. Additionally, further investigation is needed to find out the performance of the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network (BiLSTM) when combined with optimization of signal processing and adjustment of hyperparameters. In this article, we introduce a novel hybrid approach named CEEMDAN-QPSO-BiLSTM, which combines three techniques - Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN), Quantum behaved Particle Swarm optimization (QPSO), and BiLSTM - for predicting water quality parameters. To evaluate the effectiveness of this hybrid model, we developed four benchmark models, namely LSTM, BiLSTM, PSO-BiLSTM, and QPSO-BiLSTM, and compared their predictive accuracy with that of our hybrid approach. The training and testing of these models utilized actual water quality data from the Chinese National Marine Environmental Monitoring Center’s official system, specifically focusing on Dissolved Oxygen (DO), pH value, and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) parameters. The experimental results show that the CEEMDAN-QPSO-BiLSTM surpasses the baseline models, providing better error performance and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent 5G Network Slicing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Based on the intelligent 5G network slicing framework, this article proposes a construction scheme for Seq2Seq traffic prediction model based on optimized neural networks, which accelerates the construction speed of deep neural networks and achieves the goal of mining deep information of data while efficiently constructing models. At the same time, a network slicing encapsulation algorithm based on mixed integer linear programming is proposed to encapsulate virtual network requests into physical networks, without deleting any virtual networks that have been configured into the physical network. Through the method proposed in this article, the accuracy of traffic prediction is above 95%, and the network congestion rate is below 4%.

articleTitle: Rethinking the Game of Adversarial Robustness and Generalization with Diverse Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Deep neural networks are suffering potential and critical hidden danger when facing adversarial examples, which poses great threat on artificial intelligence applications. Generally speaking, a generalizable model has more accuracy on clean data. But when considering adversarial examples, which add intended and imperceptible perturbations on clean data, a model should be more robust on adversarial attacks to have more accuracy on adversarial examples. In this paper, we propose an input diversity method to balance the adversarial robustness and network generalization. It leverages the baseline methods with probability strategy to control the white-box rate and black-box rate. Experiments verify that the proposed method maintains relatively high white-box rate while boosting considerable black-box rate.

articleTitle: Optimization of an improved YOLOv5s algorithm for tomato identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The main technical difficulties in designing a picking robot are positioning and recognition, which are essential to improve the working efficiency of the robot. These difficulties need to be solved in order to reduce production costs, reduce labor intensity and improve operation efficiency. Based on Yolov5s, swim-Transformer attention mechanism is added in this paper, which can improve the accuracy and robustness of the model. The experimental results showed that the improved YOLOV5-SWINL had the highest identification accuracy of 91.622% and the highest recall rate of 88.369%, which increased the accuracy rate of 0.878% and the recall rate of 2.211% compared with the original YOLOv5 s model. It provides a better theoretical support for the picking robot to identify and position more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Memory in Orbit Fault Diagnosis Algorithm Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: As a key component in space products, memory will have a significant impact on space electronic systems if it fails on orbit. This will result in serious challenges to the safety and reliability of the entire system operation. Traditional fault diagnosis methods, such as “timed detection” and “post maintenance”, can no longer meet the reliability requirements of spacecraft complex systems. Machine learning has the advantages of fast speed and high accuracy in the field of fault diagnosis. By utilizing machine learning based fault diagnosis methods and constructing fitting functions through internal complex algorithms, fault data can be fully utilized to improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis. This paper researches a memory fault diagnosis algorithm based on machine learning, which can be modeled and trained using the memory feature dataset. When a system failure occurs, the trained fault diagnosis model can be used to analyze the memory fault parameters. This algorithm can identify and diagnose memory faults quickly and accurately. Based on the diagnostic results, quick treatment can be made, and conductive to improving the safety and reliability of the system operation.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Tobacco Products Based on Knowledge Graph with Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: During the last decade, the new brand of tobacco is designed in personal demand, thus how to make the proper sale strategy for the new production of tobacco has captured the main attention of enterprises. Constructing the correlation between the new brand and the old tobacco can help to make a sale strategy, however, the existing methods are still challenged by effectiveness and efficiency when dealing with the large-scale tobacco relationship-based graph. Addressing the issue, we propose a novel correlation analysis of tobacco products based on a knowledge graph with a graph neural network. In specific, based on the real-world collected tobacco data (e.g., brand, sale history, attributes), a knowledge graph of massive tobacco products is implemented, and correlation analysis is carried out between the old tobacco and the new one, and then the sale strategy of the new tobacco products can be laid out according to the correlation. Afterward, the edge regression model of the graph neural network is adopted and trained by the semi-supervised learning method with the adjacency matrix as the output, which represents the similarity of two tobacco products. Consequently, based on the similarity degree between the new product and other tobacco, we can make a precise prediction of the sales trend of the new product tobacco.

articleTitle: User Preference Learning Based Proactive Content Caching in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the widespread deployment of 5G networks, wireless network traffic has witnessed a sharp increase. Leveraging Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) technology to cache content at the network edge can effectively reduce the load on network backhaul traffic and provide users with low-latency, high-bandwidth services. However, existing proactive caching solutions mostly rely on content popularity, often neglecting user preferences. Therefore, this paper introduces a user preference learning based proactive caching strategy (UPLPC). Specifically, it utilizes convolutional collaborative filtering to capture user preferences and enhances the network’s expressiveness through a channel attention mechanism. Subsequently, a fully connected neural network is utilized to predict user preferences for different content. Experimental results indicate that UPLPC can enhance the accuracy of user preference prediction and increase cache hit ratio on edge servers.

articleTitle: Survival Prediction of Heart Failure Patients Based on a Novel Decision Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Survival prediction studies in patients with heart failure are of significant importance. We collected case data sets of various signs of heart failure patients, performed data preprocessing and data exploration analysis, and then proposed a novel decision tree model to classify and predict six patient signs, and further adjusted and optimized the model’s parameters, and finally obtained evaluation indicators such as accuracy, recall, precision, F1 score, and confusion matrix of decision trees. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the accuracy and recall rate of the decision tree model after model optimization reached 80.00% and 76.92% respectively. Our studies play a vital role in improving the management and outcomes of individuals living with heart failure.

articleTitle: High Speed Data Transmission Model for Optical Fiber Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at improving the performance of high data bandwidth and reducing the high transmitting packet loss for the optical fiber bus, this paper proposing a data transmitting system module based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). The novelty of this module is that this module has higher transmission performance, such as high bandwidth, low transmitting packet loss and well generality compared to other traditional DMA method. The model uses the axi-stream protocol to achieve automatic reading of Direct Memory Access (DMA), replacing the traditional DMA interrupt reading method, reducing the occupation of processor interrupt resources. The front-end First In First Out (FIFO) cache and back-end data format conversion logic enable configurable data width and flexible arrangement of data formats, reducing the CPU’s operations on data formats in high-speed mode and saving processor resources. Additionally, this model improves data transmission bandwidth by extending the axi-pcie ip data width and using MSI interrupts. Compared to the Xilinx xdma ip transfer performance under the same hardware environment and data source conditions, the data transmission system in this paper has better bandwidth performance and can achieve packet loss-free transmission under full bandwidth conditions.

articleTitle: A Matrix Decomposition Recommendation Algorithm Introducing Untrusted Information between Users
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the problems of poor recommendation performance caused by sparse data in traditional recommendation algorithms and slow convergence speed caused by the fact that the values of trust matrix elements can be any real number, this paper proposes a non negative matrix decomposition algorithm based on trust and non trust information, which comprehensively utilizes user historical information data and trust and non trust information between users. In the algorithm design, non negative constraints were applied to the potential factors of the rating matrix and trust matrix, while negative constraints were applied to the potential factors of the distrust matrix; At the same time, a novel trust regularization and distrust regularization method was also designed for model training. Experiments have shown that compared with SVD++ and TrustSVD, this algorithm not only overcomes the impact of sparse traditional data on recommendation quality to a certain extent, but also effectively enhances the robustness of the algorithm, greatly improving the accuracy of recommendations.

articleTitle: Constrained Hard-Soft Subspace Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In high-dimensional data, clusters are in subspaces of the original space. Traditional hard subspace search clustering algorithms selected dimensions, while soft projected algorithms assign weights to each dimension. In this paper, we propose a Constrained Hard-Soft Subspace Clustering algorithm which integrates hard subspace search and soft subspace weighting mechanism in one framework by introducing pairwise constraints. In the hard subspace search step, constraints are utilized to break the circular dependency by introducing must-link dimension relevance. In the soft subspace generation and data assignment step, we develop a novel optimization objective function which panelizes the constraint violation. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms typical hard and soft subspace clustering algorithms in real world data sets, and its scalability is comparable to traditional subspace clustering algorithms.

articleTitle: Nuclear radiation emergency inspection system based on UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: A UAV-based nuclear radiation emergency inspection system has been developed, employing a UAV as a flying platform equipped with a comprehensive suite of detection and control systems. The hardware seamlessly integrates components such as a Cesium Iodide (CsI) gamma detector, ground-ranging capabilities, GPS positioning, wireless communication, meteorological sensors, air collection mechanisms, video imaging systems, and more. The system employs a point kernel integration algorithm to address the mathematical principles behind the analysis of the radioactive source’s location from extensive detection data. On the software side, it automates the processing of all system data and facilitates collaborative operation among various modules. Comprehensive real-world measurements unequivocally demonstrate that the system’s technical indicators such as stability, sensitivity and adaptability meet user requirements, and can be widely used in radiation monitoring of nuclear power plants, transportation and storage monitoring of nuclear materials, and emergency response to nuclear radiation accidents, helping relevant institutions and professionals respond quickly to radiation source leaks or incidents to ensure the safety of the public and the environment.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Baseband Impedance of Envelope Tracking Power Amplifiers to Improve the Drain Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative method for enhancing the drain efficiency of envelope tracking class B power amplifiers (PA). It increases the baseband impedance of the PA by optimizing the output matching network to reduce the current consumption of the supply modulator. First, the model of baseband impedance and its theoretical relationship with drain efficiency are derived under the two-tone signal excitation. Then, by analyzing the output matching network of PA, the DC block capacitor and the size of matching circuits are modified to reduce the baseband power loss on the RF load. Finally, a 10W GaN PA excited by a 20MHz LTE signal with 7dB PAPR is used to verify the theory. 8.72% average drain efficiency improvement proves its effectiveness on broadband modulated signals with high PAPR.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ethernet Interface Based on F28335 and W5500
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Vehicle Control Unit (VCU) is the core controller of the whole vehicle control, which usually manages each system of the vehicle through the automobile bus. In this paper designs an embedded system developed specifically for VCU Ethernet communication. The system uses TI’s TMS320F28335 microcontroller as the processing unit. For the characteristics of the processing chip itself, the network chip is used to adopt the W5500 Ethernet chip with integrated TCP/IP protocol. In order to realize the data sending and receiving function, the Ethernet communication function of the whole vehicle VCU is realized through the virtual SPI bus connection method of the I/O interface of F28335.

articleTitle: Glass Bottle Mouth Defect Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the traditional detection of glass bottle mouth defects, it is difficult to realize fast and accurate detection of glass bottle mouth defects due to large changes in the gray value of some bottle mouth defects and more edge interference. Therefore, an improved algorithm model based on YOLOv5s is proposed. Firstly, replace the convolution Conv in the original network with GhostNet module to improve the real-time detection speed of the model; Secondly, a simpler and more efficient multi-scale fusion BiFPN is adopted to better realize the multi-scale feature fusion; Finally, EIOU loss function is used to replace the original CIOU loss function to improve the accuracy of the model. The experimental structure on the bottle mouth defect data set shows that the improved YOLOv5s-GBE algorithm improves the map value by 4.2%, The detection speed is 47f/s, Reduced model size by 47.5%, improving the accuracy of detection to a certain extent and making it easier to deploy.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Learning for Images Classification Considering Feature Variance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Few-shot learning aims to solve the problem of learning with limited samples. However, existing metric-based meta-learning models have the issue of insufficient attention to feature representation capability. Therefore, this paper introduces the feature variance loss during network training to learn more powerful features. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves good learning performance on the miniImageNet and tieredImageNet datasets.

articleTitle: Improving seismic facies classification and estimating uncertainty through Label Refinery
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Among the three main components (data, labels, and models) of a supervised learning system, studying labels has received very little attention. We often convert categorical values into one-hot encoding when we train a multi-class classification model such as facies classification. But it is easy to cause overfitting and overconfidence due to noisy labels and geological sense. In this work, we observed common shortcomings in the labels of facies classification, and we introduce the Label Refineryscheme. We make a prior label and then iterate through several successions of training a new model by using the previously trained model as a Label Refiner. And the subsequent network models are trained with more accurate labels. By applying the method to F3 dataset, our results show improvements in validation accuracy during successive stages of refinement. And for the model with less overconfidence, we present an approach for estimating the uncertainty of classification results by calculating prediction entropy.

articleTitle: Large Capacity Data Hiding in Binary Image black and white mixed regions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Information hiding technology utilizes the insensitivity of human sensory organs to redundant data, hiding confidential information in the redundant data of these public digital media, and then transmitting it. The carrier media after hiding secret information only displays its own characteristics, which can ensure the transmission of confidential information without being detected, thereby greatly improving the security of the information. In theory, any digital media including image, video, audio, and text can serve as a host carrier. Among them, hiding information in binary images poses great challenges. As we know, any information hiding method involves modifying the data of the host carrier. The more information hidden, the more data of the host carrier are modified. In this paper, we propose information hiding in the black-and-white mixed region of binary images, which can greatly reduce visual distortion. In addition, we propose an efficient encoding to achieve high-capacity information hiding while ensuring image semantics. By selecting binary images of different themes, we conduct experiments. The experimental results prove the feasibility of our technique and verify the expected performance. Since the candidate units for information hiding are selected from equally sized blocks that the image is divided into, and the hiding and extraction of information are based on a shared encoding table, the computational cost is very low, making it suitable for real-time information hiding applications.

articleTitle: Data Enhancement Based on YOLOv5 Medical Surgical Glove Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The re-installation of the camera leads to the problem of rotating the photos collected previously during the process of medical surgical gloves recognition. This paper rotates, translates, stratifies, inverts and other processing methods to enhance the number of data sets. The experiment adopted YOLOv5 is conducted by training the original data and the enhanced data and testing the different sets. After comparing the recognized results, it is shown that the enhanced method is useful for the enhanced data sets and the system accuracy is improved obviously.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Traffic Safety Facilities Using DINO Algorithm in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In an era of rapid technological advancement, the deep integration of computer technology with various fields, including traffic engineering, has become increasingly profound. Traditional methods of facility inspection and management suffer from inefficiencies and incomplete information, challenges that are effectively addressed by the intelligent and automated capabilities of computer technology. This pioneering study employs the DINO deep learning algorithm, focusing on comprehensive facility inspection and proposing an efficient intelligent recognition model. The model achieves an outstanding mean Average Precision (mAP) of 80.6%. Simultaneously, the article compares the training results of DINO with its predecessors, DN-DETR and Deformable DETR, highlighting the significant performance advantage of DINO. In comparison to previous research, this study places greater emphasis on the identification of various types of traffic safety facilities, further significantly enhancing the efficiency of traffic facility management and road safety.

articleTitle: A 3D Multi-Modal Network for MRI Fast Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has the advantages of non-ionizing radiation, multi-directional scanning, multi-orientation scanning and high resolution. However, its acquisition time is long, which can easily lead to patient discomfort and motion artifacts. Traditional technologies include compressed sensing and parallel imaging to accelerate imaging, and in more recent years, deep learning has also been employed for MRI fast reconstruction. On the other hand, imaging the same site with different parameters (modalities) is frequently necessary for more accurate and comprehensive radiological assessment. However, multi-modal methods, as opposed to earlier single-modal reconstruction techniques, can make use of correlation data between various modality images to produce better reconstruction outcomes. Based on this, we propose a 3D multi-modal MRI fast reconstruction network. The experimental results show that, compared with other methods, the 3DMMNet network achieves better experimental results in PSNR, SSIM, and NMSE metrics, showing the efficacy and superiority of the network.

articleTitle: A Lidar SLAM Algorithm Based on Improved LIO-SAM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) technology, widely employed for perception and localization, constitute an indispensable component for autonomous positioning and perception of unknown environments in unmanned vehicles and mobile robots. This paper employs a tightly coupled factor graph optimization method, building upon the LIO-SAM algorithm. Additionally, improvements are made by optimizing loop-closure detection factors using the Lidar-Iris method, providing it with relocalization capabilities. The proposed enhancements are validated using datasets and tested on outdoor environments with varying degrees of loop closures. The results indicate a significant improvement in positioning accuracy, making it more effective in map construction within unfamiliar environments.

articleTitle: Design of 550kV GIS/HGIS Temperature Characteristic Data Acquisition and Processing System under Extreme Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: GIS equipment has been widely used in power transmission engineering due to its advantages of high reliability and small size. Different from normal-temperature areas, low-temperature and high-cold areas pose challenges to the normal use of GIS. For example, in low temperature areas, the liquefaction of SF6, the low temperature characteristics of the structure and materials should be considered. In order to cope with low temperature application scenarios, in addition to reducing air pressure and gas mixing, the use of heating cables has become the main way to ensure gas performance. This paper proposes a design scheme for the acquisition device of the tracing belt for 550kV GIS/HGIS. On the basis of multi-point temperature acquisition, the Kalman algorithm is used for filtering, and the design of the host computer is completed. This study can provide theoretical guidance for the design of GIS tracing belts.

articleTitle: Harmonic and interharmonic frequency estimation algorithm based on ESPRIT under segmented
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The increasing severity of harmonic and interharmonic issues in power systems necessitates their detection to facilitate research into their generation mechanisms and suppression techniques, making this a crucial area of study. This paper introduces a segmented coprime sampling-based Estimating Signal Parameter via Rotational Invariance Techniques (ESPRIT) algorithm that reduces the sampling rate, thereby alleviating hardware burden. The employed ESPRIT algorithm, due to its utilization of the rotational invariance property of rotation factors and its lack of requirement for spectral peak search, offers a reduction in computational complexity compared to the direct Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that this approach outperforms traditional coprime sampling methods in terms of estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: A Seafood Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the problem of low accuracy in underwater target detection and recognition, this article establishes a dataset of marine products in complex underwater environments and proposes an underwater target detection model based on improved YOLOv5s. The model uses VariFocal Loss to calculate classification loss and solve the problem of imbalanced positive and negative samples. The bottom layer of the model structure is constructed using a cross scale feature fusion layer to obtain a larger receptive field, and a global attention mechanism module is introduced into the YOLOv5s backbone network, Enhance feature extraction, enhance the ability to collect features, and improve the accuracy of underwater target detection. The test results show that the improved model achieves an average accuracy of 71.5% for underwater target recognition, which is 6.3 percentage points and 3.7 percentage points higher than the YOLOv5s and YOLOv51 algorithms, respectively, making it more suitable for underwater target detection tasks.

articleTitle: Research on temperature compensation algorithm based on optical fiber inertia combination
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current status quo and implementation method of fiber optic gyro temperature compensation, proposes a solution to the problem that the gyro zero position is generally dispersed and large in a certain temperature range, establishes a compensation model, designs an algorithm and conducts experimental verification. The analysis of the verification results shows that the improved scheme effectively reduces the temperature compensation error and improves the accuracy of the angular velocity channel of the gyroscope of the system. At the same time, the experimental method is generalized and analyzed, which provides a strong technical reference for subsequent related R&D and production.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis on Performance of Mixer Distortion for the Field Effect Transistor Mixer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The mixer distortion is simulated and analyzed by using the LTspice software. The influence of the different parameters such as static operating point, local oscillator voltage amplitude and load resistance on the output is studied by changing the circuit parameters. Whether the output signal is distorted or not comparative analysis between theoretical calculation and simulation by setting the useful signal with different frequencies and different amplitudes), local oscillator signal and interference signal. Through the simulation experiment, the simulation results can be displayed visually and intuitively, which can enhance students’ perceptual understanding of abstract index parameter, can master the debugging method of circuit performance, and can deepen students’ understanding of basic principles. The practice has proved that this visual simulation teaching method is beneficial to display the teaching contents from mixer and mixer distortion, improve learning interest and improve learning effect.

articleTitle: Sound Event Detection Using Multi-Scale Dense Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network with Lightweight Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Neural network based sound event detection has attracted considerable attention due to high detection accuracy. Existing sound event detection algorithms often improve performance by constructing deeper and more complex detection models. To address the issue of high computational complexity in existing high performance sound event detection algorithms, this paper proposes a sound event detection algorithm using multiscale dense convolutional recurrent neural network with lightweight attention (MS-AttDenseNet-RNN). It utilizes multiscale dense convolutional neural network with lightweight attention (MS-AttDenseNet) to capture information from different scales of sound signal receptive fields and then generates importance-enhanced multi-scale feature. Finally, recurrent neural network (RNN) is used to model the temporal dependency of the enhanced multi-scale features. Compared to the system model that won the DCASE challenge, this method achieves a 18.9% improvement in F1 score and a 4.0% reduction in error rate, while reducing the number of parameters by 75.8% and the computational complexity by 47.5%. This demonstrates that the proposed method can achieve lower parameter count and computational complexity while maintaining accuracy.

articleTitle: Public Perception and Sentiment of ChatGPT: Machine Learning Analysis on Weibo Posts
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: ChatGPT, a large, pre-trained language model, which is developed by OpenAI, has exerted a great influence on society in all aspects since its launch. Knowing the adopters’ perspectives, preferences and sentiment is of critical significance for a technological company to promote and improve its products. Such social media as YouTube and Weibo, offer a convenient and time-saving channel for opinion mining. In this paper, 67,985 Weibo posts ranging from December 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023 were analyzed to explore the main topics and sentiment of users by employing machine learning techniques, including latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) topic modeling algorithm and sentiment analysis. The results suggest that more than half of the adopters expressed a positive attitude towards all topics. However, a small portion of users have expressed worry and concern about the impact of ChatGPT on education and career compared to the other two topics, the development of the AI industry and the introduction of ChatGPT. This paper, while further proving the applicability of social media to explore the public’s opinion toward a new technology, offers insights into and contributes to the development and popularity of ChatGPT by figuring out Chinese users’ perspectives and sentiment.

articleTitle: AFDX network system simulation design based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Avionics Full Duplex Switched Ethernet (AFDX) has been widely used in civil aircraft avionics systems because of its advantages of low cost, delay, high reliability, real-time performance and strong scalability. The performance of AFDX network has a direct influence on the real-time data transmission, the integrity and effectiveness of information transmission of airborne avionics system. It is difficult for traditional tests to simulate on-site working conditions. Therefore, OPNET network simulation tools are used to conduct high-precision simulation and modeling of AFDX terminals and AFDX switches, and a semi-physical AFDX network system composed of simulation parts and physical parts is built as the target object of network analysis and optimization. Finally, the performance of the constructed network system is tested by means of network acquisition and monitoring, which provides an effective verification method for the performance analysis and network optimization of avionics network system. The design can improve the reliability and quality of airborne network, and play a guiding role in practical application and product design.

articleTitle: Multi-label Text Classification using GloVe and Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study explores multi-label text classification challenges, focusing on imbalanced datasets, variable text lengths, and diverse feature labels. We propose a hybrid approach combining the GloVe model-based bag-of-words with a CNNBiLSTM neural network. This method leverages pre-trained Globe embeddings for efficient text representation, feeding into a CNN-BiLSTM network for classification. The approach demonstrates notable efficiency, achieving 87.26% accuracy and an F1 score of 0.8737 on the test set, indicating its potential for practical application in text classification tasks.

articleTitle: Dynamically Aware Mask Position for Old Films Restoration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Films restoration is a challenging yet promising task that involves using deep learning techniques to restore both structured and unstructured defects in old films. Significant progress has been made in this task by leveraging Vision Transformer and other existing technologies. However, there is still room for improvement in accurately localizing structured mask positions. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel module called the Mask-Aware (MA) module. By incorporating this module, our proposed model can achieve more precise mask positions and obtain higher-quality restoration results. Specifically, the MA module utilizes dynamic convolutions that employ attention mechanisms and deformable convolutions to enhance the ability of the model to perceive spatiotemporal information, thereby boosting the ability of the model to localize masks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model can achieve better handling of structural defects in old films.

articleTitle: Integrated Data Preprocessing Strategies for Improved Water Demand Prediction: A Case Study with the Informer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Predicting water demand poses a challenge for water utility companies, primarily due to data loss and anomalies that occur during the data collection process. However, most research on water quantity prediction tends to focus more on constructing models rather than on data processing. The main objective of this study is to tackle this issue by preprocessing the dataset to improve the predictive capability of the model. This is achieved by maximizing the resolution of anomalies, missing values, and noise. The methods employed in this study involve various data preprocessing techniques applied to time series data, including outlier handling, missing value imputation, and noise smoothing. For missing value imputation, a method combining Random Forest and K-Nearest Neighbor (RF-KNN) is proposed. Additionally, the preprocessed data is fed into the Informer model. Through optimal preprocessing, there is a noticeable improvement in the evaluation metrics. The optimal preprocessing combinations have resulted in an 85.13% improvement in Mean Squared Error (MSE) and an 83.86% improvement in different models. However, the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) has increased by 42.17% and 37.97% respectively. Comparative analysis and discussions further demonstrate that the ensemble preprocessing methods of Interquartile Range (IQR), RF-KNN, and Fourier Transform (FT) significantly enhance the predictive accuracy and reliability of the model when applied to water datasets.

articleTitle: Liver Tumor Synthesis and Segmentation Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Tumor segmentation in liver computed tomography (CT) imaging is clinically valuable to assist physicians in diagnosis and prognosis. However, limited labeled data limits segmentation accuracy. In this study, to enrich the training data, we used a label-free method to generate a mask containing tumor regions for liver CT images, then superimposed the tumor regions with liver region masks and synthesized liver CT images with tumor regions using the superimposed masks with generative adversarial networks (GANs). Finally, we verified the effect of image synthesis using manual discrimination, deep learning model segmentation and other methods. The experimental results show that the tumors synthesized by GANs have realistic shapes and textures, which can be confused with real tumors even by professional doctors. In addition, the synthesized tumor images enhance the effectiveness of segmentation models trained on real tumor images, and the proposed tumor synthesis method outperforms other studies. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed image synthesis method.

articleTitle: Improving Referring Expression Comprehension by Suppressing Expression-unrelated Proposals
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The prevailing referring expression comprehension (REC) method is based on two stages: 1) detecting multiple candidate proposals using an object detector and 2) aligning proposals with text descriptions. Existing two-stage models have achieved significant improvements with excellent alignment modules. However, their alignment modules treat each proposal equally without filtering expression-unrelated proposals. These expression-unrelated proposals may interfere with the alignment modules’ ability to accurately reason about the target proposal. These proposals also increase the difficulty of training alignment modules. To solve this problem, we propose a new framework, that can suppress expression-unrelated proposals for alignment modules. Specifically, we first design a suppression module, which calculates the relevance scores between the proposals and the expression by using the semantics in the expression. Then, these scores are integrated into three basic alignment modules, including subject, location, and relationship modules, to guide each module to focus on the expression-related proposals. We conduct extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, and the results show the effectiveness of our suppression module and performance improvement.

articleTitle: GCPNet: Global-Context Pyramid Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The detection of infrared weak small targets often presents substantial challenges due to their small size, remote distance, and low contrast, exacerbated by external factors such as atmospheric interference. While data-driven methods based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have significantly improved detection performance, existing networks remain susceptible to background noise and interference, especially within complex backgrounds. The absence of effective feature fusion also suggests that targets may get lost in deeper network layers, making the direct application to infrared small target detection challenging. To address these issues, we propose a multi-scale infrared small target detection network named Global-Context Pyramid Network (GCPNet). GCPNet employs a Pooling Dual-Route Feature Fusion Module (PRFM), effectively promoting the interactive fusion of multi-layer features, and introduces a Guided Attention Module (GAM), substantially enhancing the discriminatory ability for high-value target features. Experimental results on the SIRSTAUG and MDvsFAcGan datasets demonstrate that our GCPNet performs remarkably well, notably outperforming existing methods under complex background and weak texture conditions.

articleTitle: A Resistor-Based Temperature Sensor with an Inaccuracy of ± 0.14 °C (3σ) from −40 °C to 85 °C
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article presents a compact, highly accurate resistor-based temperature sensor, it consists of highly temperature sensitive Silicided diffusion p-poly resistors with positive temperature coefficient and Nonsilided n-poly resistors with negative temperature coefficient to form a Wheatstone bridge temperature sensing module, whose output current is quantized by a second-order single-bit Continuous time delta sigma modulator (CTDSM) to obtain the temperature information. The sensor consumes 75 µA at a supply voltage of 1.8 V, and the temperature error is only 0.14°C (3σ) over the temperature range of −40°C to 85°C. The sensor is implemented in a 0.1µm CMOS technology with an area of only 0.11 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Simple modeling of a novel fuzzy memristor PID controller
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the issue of challenging adjustments and the lack of online adaptability for traditional analog PID controllers when dealing with varying controlled objects, an innovative fuzzy multiterminal memristor device is proposed. This innovation enables real-time adjustments of controller parameters. Additionally, a solution is introduced to tackle the complexity of determining the memristor’s resistance value. A fuzzy algorithm is integrated with the memristor-based PID controller, resulting in the development of a fuzzy memristor PID control system. This system achieves adaptive parameter adjustments. Building on theoretical foundations, simulations using Multisim and practical circuit experiments are conducted. The outcomes demonstrate that the fuzzy memristor PID control system outperforms the conventional analog PID controller, offering robust online adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on technologies of accelerated processing module based on VU13P
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In view of the problems that the current accelerated processing module can not meet the requirements of application scenarios, low speed and low versatility, the development demand of accelerated processing module based on Ultrascale+ VU13P chip is proposed. Using DDR4-based memory optimization method, the computing speed of the accelerated processing module is effectively improved. The main FPGA chips are interconnected through Serdes, and the line rate can reach 25Gbps. The peripheral component interconnect express (PCIe), Ethernet, and Serial RapidIO (SRIO) bus interfaces are configured for external data exchange and transmission. This design realizes module OBC management based on Zynq (7000 All Programmable SoC), and solves power-on time sequence management through Complex Programmable Logic Device (CPLD). The two jointly build the overtemperature protection mechanism. The accelerated processing module proposed in this paper has high signal transmission rate, high universality and strong reliability, and is suitable for a wider range of application scenarios. The final test results show that the design of this paper can realize the key functions of the accelerated processing module.

articleTitle: ADS-B signal tracking method based on LSTM network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The target tracking of the Automatic Dependent Surveillance – Broadcast (ADS-B) with the help of low earth orbit satellite (LEO) achieve large-scale, all-weather and long-term signal source location tracking, which is of certain significance for aircraft flight path planning. In this paper, an ADS-B signal tracking approach takes a LEO as an target tracking terrace, calculates the direction of arrival (DOA) of the target signal, and devises a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to realize the location tracking of the signal source. The rationality of the approach is analyzed using STK and MATLAB evaluation model.

articleTitle: RWKV-based Encoder-Decoder Model for Code Completion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Intelligent code completion techniques, which offer code suggestions, are essential for assisting programmers in reducing errors and improving programming efficiency. Traditional Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) face challenges in terms of training efficiency, representation performance, and architecture extensibility. We introduce RWKV, the latest parallel trainable RNN architecture, to tackle these challenges. Additionally, we propose a new code completion model that leverages RWKV. The model utilizes an encoder-decoder framework to optimize the use of temporal and structural aspects of the code. It learns the mapping between the concrete syntax tree of the source code and the source code to identify exceptional correspondences. This approach leads to more accurate complementation outcomes. Based on experimental results, our model outperforms the baseline model in three metrics: Accuracy, EM, and Edit Sim.

articleTitle: User Clustering Scheme for NOMA in Aviation Data Link
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study presents a user clustering methodology tailored to military aviation data links, predicated on Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA). The approach initially applies K-means algorithm for initial user clustering, grounded in spatial distribution attributes. Following this preliminary phase, a genetic algorithm is deployed to further refine pairing optimization within each pre-existing user cluster, thereby finalizing the user clustering configuration. In the final stages, a series of comparative simulation experiments are conducted to affirm that the proposed algorithm not only showcases lower complexity but also outperforms traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning Methods in Carbon Emission Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper aims to explore techniques for forecasting carbon emissions using gated cyclic unit (GRU) neural networks. Firstly, historical carbon emissions data from various countries were collected and data preprocessing was carried out; then, a GRU neural network-based prediction model was developed to learn the characteristics of time series data; In order to enhance the precision of the model, adjustments and optimizations to the model’s parameters were made continually; finally, the performance of the model was assessed through simulation experiments and compared to other frequently employed prediction methods. The experimental results show that the GRU-based neural network model exhibits excellent performance in the carbon emissions prediction task with higher prediction accuracy and stability. The method provides an effective and feasible method for carbon emissions prediction, which helps the government and enterprises to make more scientific decisions in environmental protection and carbon emissions control. Future research can further explore how to combine data from other fields, such as economic data and weather data, to further improve the accuracy of carbon emissions prediction.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Approach for Wind Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the growing global energy demand and requirement for environmental protection, renewable energy is attracting attention as a vital development direction. Particularly, wind power is rapidly developing as a clean and sustainable form of energy. Nonetheless, wind speed uncertainty and system dynamics make wind power prediction and optimization complex and challenging. Accurate wind power prediction is essential to improve system reliability and performance. In this regard, traditional forecasting methods have limitations in some cases. In this study, based on XGBoost and decision tree with Bagging methods in ensemble learning, wind power data is predicted. The results indicated that better performances than the traditional linear regression and ordinary decision tree models are achieved, revealing the efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Application of high performance one-dimensional chaotic map in key expansion algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a key expansion algorithm based on a high-performance one-dimensional chaotic map. Traditional one-dimensional chaotic maps exhibit several limitations, prompting us to construct a new map that overcomes these shortcomings. By analyzing the structural characteristics of classic ID chaotic maps, we propose a high-performance ID map that outperforms multidimensional maps introduced by numerous researchers in recent years. In block cryptosystems, the security of round keys is of utmost importance. To ensure the generation of secure round keys, a sufficiently robust key expansion algorithm is required. The security of round keys is assessed based on statistical independence and sensitivity to the initial key. Leveraging the properties of our constructed high-performance chaotic map, we introduce a chaotic key expansion algorithm. Our experimental results validate the robust security of our proposed key expansion algorithm, demonstrating its resilience against various attacks. The algorithm exhibits strong statistical independence and sensitivity to the initial key, further strengthening the security of the generated round keys.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Sentiment Analysis System for Chinese Online Comment Texts
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The limitations of manual recognition and traditional binary sentiment analysis models, such as low efficiency, low accuracy, and high cost, have become increasingly prominent and can no longer satisfy the requirements of industrial applications. In this paper, we propose a BERT-based six-class emotion analysis model that is capable of recognizing six distinct emotions, including positive, anger, sadness, fear, surprise, and neutral. Leveraging this model, we have developed an industrial-grade Chinese online sentiment analysis system that addresses the challenges of text sentiment processing in real-life scenarios. By employing knowledge distillation and model pruning techniques, we are able to enhance the accuracy and speed of the pre-trained models. This system extracts and classifies emotional information, performs retrieval and induction, and offers robust analytical indicators and sentiment classification for individuals and enterprises. The outcomes are visually presented through word clouds or graphical representations, thereby providing a solid foundation for decision-making in the relevant fields. The proposed model achieves an F1 score of 0.78, demonstrating its effectiveness and practical applicability.

articleTitle: Multi-Object Tracking Framework Based on Multi-Scale Temporal Feature Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is a hot spot in computer vision field. There have been various related works in recent years. We propose a framework which is used for multi-object tracking tasks with multi-class in this paper. Our framework is based on one-shot method. Firstly, we propose a one-shot tracker. Secondly, we develop a frame attention module (FAM) to more effectively aggregate features of two adjacent frames. Thirdly, we introduce a convolutional block attention module for each head on each scale to decouple detection and association. Our framework based on an anchor-free detector. The effectiveness has proved by experiment.

articleTitle: Vision-based Automated Fugl-Meyer Assessment System for Upper Limb Motor Function
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The Fugl-Meyer Assessment (FMA) is an important method for evaluating upper limb motor functionality in stroke patients. However, traditional assessments by therapists not only increase the cost of labor and money, but also is subjective. In this paper, we propose a novel automated FMA system to overcome these limitations that patients cannot be accurately assessed in time. We use camera to capture the motion of the upper limb and then extract motion features. The MLP classification algorithm is developed to assign FMA scores using the features obtained from camera. Our work achieves average accuracy of 98.9% and 97.7% on a dataset of 15 volunteers and a dataset of S patients. Our result shows high accuracy and offers guidance to an automated assessment system.

articleTitle: An efficient target re-recognition method combining EfficientNet and MeMOT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the wide application of deep learning techniques in computer vision, target re-recognition has become a popular research direction. Traditional target re-recognition methods face many challenges when dealing with target matching in complex scenes and multi-camera fields of view, such as view angle changes, lighting condition differences and occlusion. In order to better cope with these challenges, this paper proposes a novel target re-recognition method combining EfficientNet and MeMOT, referred to as EN-ME. EfficientNet, as a highly efficient deep neural network, is able to extract rich features from images; while MeMOT provides strong spatio-temporal memory support for target tracking. By combining the two, our approach not only accurately matches targets, but also enables efficient target tracking in real-time video streams. We conduct experiments on several publicly available datasets such as Market-1501, DukeMTMC-reID and CUHK03. The experimental results show that the EN-ME method performs better in terms of mAP and Rank-l accuracy. In addition, we analyze the robustness, computational efficiency and scalability of the model.

articleTitle: A Neighborhood Neighbor Frame Search Denoising Algorithm Based on Time Consistency
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The identification and categorization of small mobile objects in intricate environments is a significant area of study in disciplines such as computer vision, image processing, and pattern recognition. The main changing factors of video images in complex scenes include: changes in the position or deformation of moving targets, changes in lighting conditions, self occlusion or mutual occlusion of dynamic background moving targets, and so on. In recent years, there have been significant research breakthroughs that have been extensively utilized in various domains, including military navigation, intelligent video surveillance systems, and video retrieval. Complex scenes with dynamic backgrounds pose challenges for detecting small moving targets due to their long distance, limited area, unclear texture color features, and partial loss of detail features. Hence, the crucial aspect of future image analysis and processing lies in efficiently, precisely, and comprehensively extracting small moving targets from intricate scenes, as well as doing the corresponding classification and recognition tasks. This article presents a denoising technique that utilizes a neighborhood nearby frame search approach to tackle the issue of significant background noise interference in complicated images. The algorithm is primarily focused on time consistency, which can accurately differentiate between dynamic background noise and a moving object of interest by analyzing the pixel data in a nearby frame. This allows for the successful elimination of significant background noise interference.

articleTitle: Research on state-of-charge estimation of lithium battery based on An improved adaptive unscented Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The state-of-charge (SOC) of lithium-ion batteries is one of the important parameters for the operation and maintenance of the battery management system (BMS). Fast and accurate estimation Enables security control and monitoring on-time of lithium-ion batteries. It also helps to extend the service life of the battery and improve the safety of its use. The conventional unscented Kalman filter (UKF) algorithms have the risk of negatively determining the covariance matrix when estimating the SOC of lithium-ion batteries. To address the issue of poor estimation accuracy of the algorithm, this paper proposes improvement measures. In this article, lithium iron phosphate (Li-FePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) batteries are used as the object of study and modeling the second-order RC equivalent-circuit-model (ECM). The parameters of the equivalent model are identified by the recursive least squares method FFRLS. Combined with the adaptive adjustment strategy, the AUKF algorithm is formed to realize the SOC estimation of lithium-ion battery. And the simulation model is established by Matlab/Simulink to verify its accuracy. The test results indicate that the improved AUKF algorithm can better estimate the state-of-charge of batteries. The fluctuation limit of SOC estimation error is kept at 3%. It shows that the prediction method has high accuracy, good anti-interference ability and error correction ability.

articleTitle: Integrating Velox into TinkerPop for Graph Queries on Vectorized Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To enhance the query efficiency of relational databases and build a unified computing backend, Meta has developed Velox, a vectorized execution engine library based on columnar storage, Currently, there is no standardized specification for computation engine, and storage in graph databases, leading to failed to effectively utilize the vectorized processing capability of modern CPU. In this paper, we propose a middleware that primarily focuses on (1) non-invasively integrating Velox into the TinkerPop framework to provide unified vectorized engine acceleration for all graph databases supporting the TinkerPop specification; (2) conducting graph queries based on the relational data storage model, eliminating the overhead of transforming the storage model into a graph storage model; (3) validating the acceleration effect of the vectorized engine on interactive workload of graph queries under a single-node environment.

articleTitle: Fast Algorithm for HEVC using Frequency-based Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Compared to the previous H.264 video encoding standard, High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) offers a remarkable 50% reduction in bitrate while maintaining perceptual video quality. However, this enhancement comes at the cost of significantly increased encoding complexity. In HEVC, the quad-tree partitioning of coding units (CUs) is a major contributor to this complexity, as it involves an exhaustive search for rate-distortion optimization (RDO). Many existing approaches address this issue by utilizing neural networks to predict block partition decisions, primarily focusing on the spatial domain. In our work, we take a novel approach by introducing a frequency-based network to tackle this problem from a different angle. In comparison to the original HM16.5 encoding, the proposed method of learning in the frequency domain average time reductions about 64.74%, 67.21%, 70.8% and 79.52% on average at four QPs respectively.

articleTitle: GLFormer: Efficient Global and Local Transformer with Lightweight Decoder for Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: We propose an efficient and simple semantic segmentation model, termed as GLFromer. GLFomer has two contributions. Firstly, unlike the traditional hybrid Transformer-CNN structure, we propose the global and local context extractor, named as GL-Extractor. we combinate the self-attention and convolution in one layer, which not only significantly reduces the computation cost of model, but also captures the long context dependencies and local information at the same time. Second, we introduce the up sample lightweight decoder, where we handle the feature maps only by the concatenation and non-linear operation. The results of ablation and comparative studies can demonstrate the effectiveness of our structure.

articleTitle: FastSO: A Fast Weighted Cardinality Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Weighted cardinality estimation is widely used in network traffic monitoring and database fields, such as evaluating the number and size of duplicate data packets in network traffic, estimating the popularity, trend of keywords in the database, and so on. Existing research is mostly based on data sketches for cardinality estimation, which is to establish sketches in a data stream of size n, store them in k buckets, and use statistical information to unbiased estimate the data. As the amount of data increases, the computational scale of the hash function in the sketch estimation algorithm also significantly increases. Each data needs to calculate k hash values, and the algorithm has a time complexity of O(nk). This paper proposes a weighted cardinality estimation algorithm based on random optimization and parallel acceleration. In the hash function calculation stage, the central limit theorem is used to randomly sample the data bucket, and each data only needs one sampling and one hash calculation. The average time complexity of the algorithm has been reduced to the O(n) level. In the calculation phase, multiple data are aggregated into a single piece of data, and the loop is unfolded in a vectorized manner. SIMD parallelization is used to accelerate the simultaneous calculation of multiple data. The experimental results show that this algorithm can achieve acceleration of 5 to 100 times while maintaining the accuracy of the relative baseline algorithm.

articleTitle: PLCoroner: A Novel JTAG-based PLC Memory Forensics Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) is one of the most widely used industrial equipment in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) which the PLC security has received more and more attention in recent years. PLC memory forensics is an effective PLC security protection method. However, due to the special hardware architecture, how to avoid hang and crash in the PLC memory forensics process is a challenge. In this paper, we present PLCoroner, a novel PLC memory forensics method based on the Joint Test Action Group (JTAG). With hardware evaluation, JTAG pin identification, memory mapping and result analysis, the PLCoroner greatly improved the reliability and stability of PLC memory forensics. Compared with traditional methods, PLCoroner effectively avoiding the existing problems such as easy crash and limited memory address. Experimental results also show that for the current mainstream PLC security threats, PLCoroner can complete attack forensics and threat discovery in a few seconds, which provides more theoretical and practical references for PLC forensic analysis and security protection.

articleTitle: Research on Boosting Canny Edge Detection Performance with DCT and NLM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Low altitude aerial target detection is essential for military, civil aviation, and unmanned aerial system applications. However, conventional Canny edge detection algorithms have limitations that impede performance in noisy environments. Specifically, they are prone to losing faint edge information during noise filtering owing to poor adaptability with fixed parameters. To address these limitations, this study presents a modified Canny edge detection algorithm for low altitude aerial target edge detection. The proposed method substitutes the traditional Gaussian filter in the Canny algorithm with a combined discrete cosine transform (DCT) and non-local means (NLM) filtering approach. Comparative experimental results demonstrate that this novel technique exhibits excellent capabilities in edge detection and noise suppression under low altitude aerial target conditions. The findings provide an innovative solution for robust detection of low altitude aerial targets in real-world noisy environments, offering promise in advancing military, aviation, and unmanned aerial system applications.

articleTitle: A Realistic Simulation Method for the Micro-Doppler Characteristics of Helicopter Rotor Blade Radar Echo
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the simulation results are inconsistent with the actual results due to the simplified effect of rotor blade bending on echo in helicopter modeling, based on the scattering and dynamic characteristics of rotor blades, the influences of blade bending and hub rotation on modeling are analyzed. By simulating the position information of each scattering point, a refined model of helicopter radar echo is constructed. The fretting characteristics of radar echoes are analyzed theoretically. The simulation results verify the correctness and feasibility of the theoretical analysis. The establishment of this model improves the theory of rotor blade echo model, and has certain theoretical and application value in the field of detection and recognition of rotor targets.

articleTitle: Design of a Home Care System for the Elderly under the Background of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the increasingly serious aging problem and the demand for intelligent home care, this paper adopts Internet of Things technologies such as RFID indoor positioning and sensors to achieve real-time monitoring of the status of elderly people at home. The system can monitor the dangerous location or actions of the elderly in real-time by obtaining information from RFID tags and sensors, and respond, such as reminding monitoring personnel, or notifying police stations, children of the elderly, etc. The system can also provide assistance services such as regularly reminding the elderly to take medication and going to the hospital for examination. This provides an automatic and powerful monitoring and management tool for safe home life, and provides technical support for improving the level of home care.

articleTitle: Lightweight and Pair-free Certificate-Based Data Aggregation for Smart Grid
