publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the groundswell of digital and computerized equipment and technology, smart grids have received widespread attention as a method that can be relied on. Smart grids can transform a house into a home area networks, connecting multiple smart devices and appliances to the electricity control centers. However, the privacy and security of the user’s data is critical because the data from smart grids may expose users’ lifestyle habits. To solve this problem, a large number of data aggregation schemes based on public-key or identities have been presented, however, most of them have been shown to be complicated by certificate management or key escrow issues. To overcome the above problem, we construct a secure and lightweight certificate-based data aggregation (CB-DA) scheme in this work. It not only is proven secure but also avoids time-consuming pairing. Finally, our security analysis shows that the proposed scheme is secure.

articleTitle: A method for predicting bone age using Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Based on the principle of TW3 integration, this paper presents a high level of automatic bone age evaluation algorithm with high interpretation and clinical applicability. A hybrid network known as SMTNet was developed to investigate the classification of bone maturity in TW3 clinical scoring regions. The objective of this study is to obtain bone age results for the metacarpal (RUS) and carpal (C series) by including appropriate bone maturity scores. This method was trained and tested using a dataset of 5000 children’s left hand X-rays provided by a tertiary hospital in Beijing. The experimental results show that the average absolute error of the C-series bone age model is 0.52 years, while the RUS series is 0.51 years. To sum up, the method of bone age assessment presented in this paper has been successfully applied in many clinical settings.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Radio Frequency Power Amplifier Suitable for both Daily and Industrial Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Dual-band power amplifiers with high inter-band isolation have consistently been a focus of research in the current environment. Unregulated microwave transmitters can interfere with other signals, resulting in crosstalk and subsequent signal distortion, which affects signal transmission. This paper proposed the new circuit structure which can work in the GSM900 and GAA2840 frequency. The circuit adopts the coupling cavity structure, which has the function of reducing impedance mismatch and inhibiting the external signal. The design used the GaN transistor CGH40010F and implemented Rogers4350b board material. The test results show that the saturation output power is 39 dBm and 40 dBm in 900 MHz and 2.84 GHz band. The gain is about 8 dB. The power added Efficiency (PAE) is 65% and 69%. Compared with the traditional concurrent dual-band power amplifier, the amplifier structure significantly improves the matching performance, reduces the VSWR, and can well meet the development of modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Extension of the Covert Performance Evaluation System for Underwater Spread Spectrum Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In view of the current direct sequence spread spectrum underwater acoustic communication has become an important detection object of underwater acoustic non-cooperative communication detection, based on the analysis of the applicability of the current three mainstream underwater acoustic spread spectrum communication detection methods in the offshore complex multipath and low signal-to-noise ratio environment spread spectrum communication detection, a covert communication standard based on time domain autocorrelation detection is proposed, and the conventional energy detection covert standard is extended. At the same time, through simulation analysis, it is found that under the new covert communication standard, M-ary spread spectrum has better covert performance than conventional spread spectrum.

articleTitle: A depth completion method based on cross-feature extraction window
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: A Dense depth maps with clear object boundaries are very important for robot mapping and navigation. However, today’s depth sensors can only produce sparse depth data, so it is necessary to complete them. Traditional methods mostly rely on RGB images as an auxiliary modality to provide color information in the depth-filling process. However, RGB by itself is not enough to provide all the required color information, so we add semantic maps as a guide on this basis. In addition, we add a cross-feature extraction window (CFEW) based on the attention mechanism to the feature extraction stage of this model. The essence of the window is to use the channel attention mechanism, the spatial attention mechanism, and the mutual features attention mechanism to enhance the important features and suppress the irrelevant features, which can enhance the border of the object in the environment.

articleTitle: Design of 10-bit 50Ms/s asynchronous logic SAR ADC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article proposes a simple, low-power, and high-precision successive approximation analog-to-digital converter (SAR ADC). The SAR ADC designed in this article consists of three parts: a differential capacitor array, a comparator module, and a successive approximation logic module. By selecting a relatively low operating voltage and adopting a VCM-based capacitor array structure, the goal of reducing power consumption is achieved. Its high-speed characteristics are achieved through the use of asynchronous logic clock control. Based on SMIC 0.18$\mu$m-process achieves a SAR ADC with a power supply voltage of 1.8V, a sampling frequency of 50Ms/s, a significant bit of 9.9bit, and an SNDR of 61.39dB, which meets the expected design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Camouflage System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the military field, camouflage technology has always been a key research object. Integrating camouflage goals with the environment has great significance on both sides of the war. Traditional digital camouflage is primarily designed for a single background and state. Its camouflage can only have a certain effect in a fixed time and place, but with the change of place and time, its camouflage performance is greatly weakened. Therefore, camouflage technology can change with the environment in real time, which is the inevitable development direction of the future military camouflage field. This paper proposes an adaptive digital camouflage method based on deep learning. The camouflaged target is identified by object detection algorithm, and the target is repaired by image repair algorithm, so that the image can be adapted to change into the environment under different scenes.

articleTitle: EAFNet: Feature Enhancement and Self-Adaptive Guided Feature Fusion for Object Detection in Haze Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Recently, there is a significant success in the current object detection task. However, existing research has demonstrated that detectors trained on regular images experience a significant decrease when facing to wild scences such as haze scence. Although enhancing detection performance is possible through multi-stage adaptive parameter-guided image enhancement, this method fails to consistently enhance downstream object detection performance. To address this issue, we propose an end-to-end object detection framework that utilizes weakly supervised parameter-guided feature fusion to improve detection performance. Specifically, we introduce the Self-Adaptive Feature Fusion Module (SAFFM) that dynamically guides feature fusion in the detection network through the haze image information encoded by the Prior Knowledge (PK) components. By the joint learning of the PK components and the detection network in an end-to-end manner, we ensure that the PK components weakly supervise the feature fusion process to enhance detection performance. Additionally, we propose a Downsampling Feature Enhancement Module (DFEM) that utilizes multibranch down-sampling operators and reparameterization to enhance the feature extraction capability of the network, allowing it to capture more latent information. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic datasets and real datasets, demonstrated that the detection performance of the proposed network significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art detection methods.

articleTitle: A Pose Estimation Method Based on Sparsity Judgment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Monocular pose estimation is an important task in computer vision, which is widely used in robot positioning, virtual reality, autonomous navigation, and other fields. In order to achieve more accurate and low complexity pose estimation, this paper proposes a pose estimation method based on sparse facial feature judgment, and derives the influence of feature point geometric distribution on estimation error and the transmission model of feature point detection error. At the same time, considering the positioning error of different local feature points, the weight of feature points is fused, and a weighted PDOP based feature point optimization selection method is proposed to reduce the impact of data errors on pose estimation and improve the accuracy of pose estimation algorithms.

articleTitle: Method for Passive Location of UAV Conical Formation Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The pure direction-based passive positioning for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) offers the advantages of high accuracy and low cost. However, the paradigm model of this implementation method lacks solution design in real-world scenarios. A passive receiving signal drone positioning model in a circular formation with unknown transmitting signal drone numbers is established through analytical geometry analysis and enumeration search. Qualitative segmentation was performed on conical formations, combined with drone positioning methods, and selection, crossover, and mutation operators were constructed based on fitness functions. A conical formation adjustment scheme based on genetic search algorithm was designed. Afterwards, a set of conical formation test data was constructed, and after adjustment, the unmanned aerial vehicle group reached the target state with errors Q(t)$\lt$ 0.1.

articleTitle: An OFD reader based on SM2 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: OFD is a format document standard with independent intellectual property rights in China, which has the advantages of long-term availability, readability and strong scalability. Digital signature and electronic signature technologies can effectively solve the anti-tamper and anti-repudiation requirements of OFD documents. This paper studies and implements OFD signature and verification module and OFD signature reader based on SM2 and SM3 national secret algorithms, with electronic signature as the core. It is of great significance for the promotion and application of OFD and the localization of the core technology of domestic electronic document systems.

articleTitle: RCS Reduction Based on Optimization Algorithms and Novel Polarization Conversion Meta-surface
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: At present, the improvement of various new radar technologies also has higher requirements for stealth technology. In this paper, a novel broadband 1-bit polarization conversion meta-surface (PCM) is proposed and combined with various optimization algorithms to obtain coded arrays that achieve lower radar cross section (RCS) compared to the conventional checkerboard array. The PCM structure proposed in this paper consists of two asymmetric open rings, which can achieve more than 90% polarization conversion rate within 9.7-21.4 GHz. In order to verify the advantages and disadvantages of different algorithms in reducing RCS, three algorithms (simulated annealing algorithm, genetic algorithm, and particle swarm optimization algorithm) are used to optimize the coding array for this structure and simulate it, and it is found that the algorithm-optimized coding array is better than the traditional checkerboard layout in terms of RCS reduction, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is the best among them, which can be 6-25 GHz to achieve −10 dB RCS reduction.

articleTitle: Efficient Model Compression in Super Resolution via Ghost Module with Minimal Angle Regularization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The past years have witnessed remarkable achievements in large-scale deep models. Nevertheless, their broad implementation on resource-constrained devices faces significant obstacles due to considerable computational complexity and extensive storage demands. To address these challenges, various approaches, such as model compression and neural architecture design, have been proposed. GhostNet, a lightweight network architecture, exploits the redundancy of feature maps by categorizing convolution filters into primary and cheap filters. Nonetheless, the limited number of primary filters, coupled with a high compression ratio, restrains the network’s expressiveness. Drawing inspiration from regularization methods targeting the angular diversity of neurons, we introduce a novel approach to augment GhostNet’s performance. Specifically, we propose the integration of maximizing minimal pairwise angles (MMA) regularization on primary filters. This augmentation aims to enhance the disparity between convolution kernels, thereby extracting more information at different levels. The MMA regularization strives to uniformly distribute the normalized weight vectors of neurons or filters on a hypersphere. Our experimental results, conducted on benchmark datasets, showcase the efficacy of the proposed method in enhancing GhostNet’s performance, particularly under higher compression ratios. This advancement opens new avenues for improving the deployment of deep models on resource-constrained devices.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Autonomous Collaborative Target Tracking in Dynamic Environment Based on Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Given the constraints associated with a single UAV performing target tracking tasks in complex environments, this study employs a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach to investigate the problem of multi-directional target tracking in a UAV swarm. The agent’s action space and state space are designed using the local observable Markov model, while the reward function for cluster target tracking is formulated based on the potential field function and the collision cone principle. Furthermore, to address the issue of over-fitting during the training process, Gaussian noise is incorporated into the joint advantage function to mitigate the influence of individual agents on the overall advantage. The simulation results demonstrate that the UAV swarm outperforms a single UAV in terms of target tracking. Furthermore, when compared to the MAPPO algorithm, the enhanced version of MAPPO exhibits superior training efficacy and target tracking performance.

articleTitle: Improvement of GM (1,1) model optimization based on the hill-climbing algorithm and its application in vehicle traffic accident studies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to accurately predict the change trend of the number of vehicle traffic accidents, this paper proposes an improved GM (1,1) model based on the hill-climbing method to solve the problem that the traditional GM (1,1) model has low accuracy in predicting data with large fluctuations. The heuristic method is used to optimize the parameter calculation method of the original model, improve the accuracy of curve fitting, and reduce the average relative residual error of the model prediction. On this basis, using the multiple sets of data of the number of real historical vehicle traffic accidents in the past ten years, the accident prediction accuracy of the traditional GM (1,1) model and the improved GM (1,1) model is compared. The experimental results show that the improved GM (1,1) model based on hill-climbing method proposed in this paper has higher fitting accuracy, and the average relative residual is lower than that of the traditional model. It is less affected by the fluctuation of data sequence and can better meet the needs of practical engineering. It can provide some support for the development of related application research and has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis method based on ICEEMDAN and Fast spectral kurtosis improved by wavelet packet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: A bearing feature extraction method based on ICEEMDAN and wavelet packet improved fast spectral kurtosis method is proposed to address the problem of pattern aliasing in bearing fault feature extraction and the shortcomings of the wavelet packet method in frequency band division. Firstly, the original vibration signal is processed using ICEEMDAN and decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs); Select out IMF components that meet the criteria of variance contribution rate and correlation coefficient, perform signal reconstruction, perform improved wavelet packet decomposition on the reconstructed signal, and calculate the improved fast spectral kurtosis based on the kurtosis criterion to obtain the improved fast spectral kurtosis graph. Furthermore, the envelope spectrum is obtained to determine the fault feature information of rolling bearings. The feasibility of this method was verified through simulation signals and experimental analysis of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis and Simulation of SiC MOSFET Considering Temperature Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Since most of the traditional SiC MOSFETs modeling methods are complicated and do not consider the effect of temperature under operating conditions, this paper proposes a datasheet-based modeling method to improve the accuracy and applicability of the model. First, the core features of SiC MOSFETs are analyzed, and by extracting the relevant information from the datasheet, a segmented model considering the effect of temperature is established in Simulink to characterize its static characteristics, and on the basis of the static model, a nonlinear fitting is performed to the parasitic capacitance affecting the switching process of the device, and a dynamic model is established by combining the effect of the body diode. Finally, to verify the accuracy of the model, the simulation results are compared with the data provided in the datasheet, and the results show that the model has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Road Anomaly Detection Algorithm Based on SimAM Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper introduces YOLO-Road, a lightweight object detection algorithm model, which integrates the SimAM attention mechanism on the basis of YOLOv7-Tiny, and improves the Loss function to SIoU Loss. In addition, we collected 3234 road disease images with professional equipment and verified the results on this dataset using YOLOv7-Tiny and YOLO-Road, respectively. The results show that the accuracy of our model mAP@0.5 reaches 0.879, which is 1% higher than that of YOLOv7-Tiny (0.855), successfully realizing the high-precision detection of multi-category road diseases.

articleTitle: Noise Suppression Method of Distributed Optical Fiber Acoustic Sensing System Based on ALO-VMD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Distributed optical fibre acoustic sensing system (DAS) can detect vibration information applied near optical fibres with high sensitivity. The direct detection mode based on amplitude demodulation can realize the monitoring of vibration data with lower sampling frequency and simpler method. However, vibration data is often drowned out by the effects of thermal noise, system fading noise and environmental noise. In order to solve the problem of noise in the system, this study proposes a noise suppression method based on ant-lion optimization algorithm (ALO) and variable mode decomposition (VMD). The algorithm can select the optimal number of decomposition layers and penalty factors adaptively. The experimental results show that the ALO-VMD algorithm has higher decomposition accuracy than VMD algorithm under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and the signal-to-noise ratio improvement is more obvious compared with the traditional noise reduction algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of PPS Self-Calibration High-Precision Frequency Meter Based on STM32 Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low precision and high cost of traditional frequency meter, this paper proposes a design method of high precision digital frequency meter based on STM32H750 series microcomputer. This method can effectively solve the problem of counting error of ±1 words in the cycle measurement method and the frequency measurement method, improve the accuracy and reduce the cost. By continuously correcting the PPS (pulse per second) signal received from the synchronous satellite, the disadvantage of the traditional measurement method is supplemented to a certain extent. Compared with traditional frequency meters, this method fully utilizes the advantages of high-speed and accurate microcontroller, and has the characteristics of small size, fast speed, and high accuracy. The design scheme of the frequency meter given in this design is not only feasible, but also simple in design, low in cost and wide in measurable frequency band, which greatly reduces the design cost and implementation complexity.

articleTitle: Power forecasting for regional distributed photovoltaic based on mRMR-TCN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid growth of photovoltaic (PV) generation capacity, the integration of distributed PV power plants in regional areas is becoming increasingly common. Therefore, accurate prediction of regional distributed PV power is crucial for the safe regulation of the power system. This paper proposes a regional distributed PV prediction method based on the maximum relevance-minimum redundancy (mRMR) criterion and time convolutional network (TCN). This method first divides a region into multiple sub-regions and uses the mRMR criterion to select representative power plants for each sub-region. Then, a TCN network is employed to predict the PV generation of the representative power plants, achieving the prediction of the entire region's PV generation. To validate the accuracy of this method, the paper conducts empirical analysis using 300 distributed PV generation data from a certain region in Australia. The experimental results show that the mRMR-TCN based regional distributed PV prediction method has higher prediction accuracy compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Enhancement via Multi-color Space Correction and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Underwater image enhancement, as an important branch of image processing, has attracted the attention of many scholars in recent years. Due to selective scattering and degradation of light in water, images captured underwater are generally of low quality. To improve the accuracy of underwater image details and color, we propose a novel underwater image enhancement model, which is based on a Multi-color space fusion (MSF) strategy and assigns corresponding weights to each color channel for fusion. Qualitative and quantitative comparisons show that the proposed method can effectively remove image blur, achieve color correction, and significantly improve image sharpness.

articleTitle: Advancements in Video Tracking Technology: A Deep Learning Approach with SiamMask
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Object tracking is a crucial research focus within computer vision and holds significant value. Nonetheless, many existing trackers exhibit suboptimal tracking performance when confronted with object deformations or disappearances. To address this issue, we have introduced an attention mechanism into the original twin network, creating an attention-based dual-branch twin network. This innovation aims to tackle deformations and object disappearance issues in tracking problems and has demonstrated promising results in experimental trials. The incorporation of the attention mechanism substantially enhances the tracking effectiveness of the tracker, with a notable boost in accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on NB-IOT Device Access Security Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: NB-IOT device access security solutions have gained more and more attention as the number of NB-IOT device is growing. There are some special characteristics for NB-IOT device access security due to some special business requirements and some NB-IOT network characteristics. To provide better solutions, the author analyzes different security solutions in different communication layers, such as network layer, transport layer and service layer. The author also analyzes some solutions crossing network layer and service layer to get better effect. The NB device access security solutions will develop in the two ways. One is to make the security protocol more light-weight. New protocol may be introduced to reduce the number of messages in the air interface for the establishment and maintenance of the security session. The other is to the improvement and deployment of the BEST architecture.

articleTitle: Prioritize Sustainable Development Goals using TOPSIS and Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are all crucial to solving global problems. To make rapid improvements with limited resources and special funds, we ranked the 17 SDGs based on factors such as cost and feasibility, as well as interaction effects of SDGs. In this paper, we propose a dynamic scoring mechanism for SDGs based on graph theory, employing the Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to the Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) algorithm and Dijkstra shortest path algorithm. By incorporating the evolving nature of SDGs, the correlation network among the goals is affected, consequently influencing the updated scoring results. The calculation results show that the highest initial score was 11, 12, 13 in SDGs, which are Sustainable Cities and Communities, Sustainable Consumption and Production, and Climate Action. Furthermore, this paper analyzes the influence of reasonable changes in SDGs on the scoring results.

articleTitle: MoE-ESRGAN: A Super-Resolution Network for Multi-degraded Chinese Painting Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The conventional super-resolution algorithms are unable to fully address the Chinese painting images that contain some artifacts and were taken many years ago. In this paper, we propose a novel SR model named MoE-ESRGAN for restoring multi-degraded Chinese painting images based on the structure of ESRGAN. To simulate the degradation of real-world Chinese painting images, this paper uses multi-degradation model, including bicubic downsampling, blur and noise, to obtain low-resolution images as our dataset. This paper further designs a new generator network by incorporates a set of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to enhance the network’s ability for mapping from low-resolution (LR) images to high-resolution (HR) images. Meanwhile, we assign the specific guidance to each expert in MoE to learn different image features. Based on the self-built Chinese painting image dataset, we compare the performance of our model with various models through experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with ESRGAN, our model has an average increase of 0.7 dB in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and an average increase of 0.03 in structural similarity (SSIM). Meanwhile, our MoE-ESRGAN model exhibits high effectiveness in image denoising and deblurring. Furthermore, the reconstructed images of our model are subjectively more in line with human visual standards.

articleTitle: Campus Proxy Application Based on Cloud Computing, Social LSTM Technology and Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: At present, college student group with heavy learning tasks and busy and tiring lives have a strong demand for the business of picking up express delivery on the way. Campuses usually have a large area, which causes inconvenience for students to eat and receive express delivery. However, existing express pickup services have many disadvantages such as cumbersome operations, low efficiency, high costs, and insecurity. This paper designs an App that allows college students to pick up express delivery on their way. It is based on Social LSTM and Extended Kalman Filter technology, and takes students in college campus as the main service objects, aiming to solve the problems in express service Apps, and meet the needs of college students for convenient and efficient life. In this paper, a model of object motion is applied to simulate the movements of college students and explore the core algorithms. The research mainly lies in trajectory prediction. In accordance to experiment results, campus proxy applications with Social LSTM and EKF technology perform better than Apps without them, so these algorithms are of great significance in path prediction.

articleTitle: Vertical directivity modelling with shallow receiver of deep-sea ambient noise
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The result of the deep-sea trial experiment suggests that when the depth of the receiver is located in 1000m, the sea surface effect can significantly affect the platform for the detection of the target. Under the effect of the high frequency component from the sea surface, the ambient ocean noise received by the receiver turns out to be anisotropic in the vertical direction, instead of becoming isotropic. Given the above-described result, the vertical directivity of deep-sea ambient noise is modelled in this study. First, four hypotheses are proposed in accordance with the deep-sea ambient noise theory. Subsequently, the correlation between vertical energy of the ocean ambient noise field and the pitch angle is developed from the perspective of acoustic intensity. Thus, the integral representation of vertical directivity function is developed. The vertical directivity at different frequencies and a range of receiving depths is numerically calculated. As revealed by the comparison with the measured ocean ambient noise data in the South China Sea, the high frequency component of the ocean ambient noise is primarily concentrated in the vertical upward sea surface. It is noteworthy that the measured data comply with the results achieved using the theoretical model.

articleTitle: A Boiler Heating Surface Overtemperature Warning Method Based on Multi source Data Fusion and Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to accurately monitor the overheating of boiler heating surfaces and ensure the safety of boiler use, this paper proposes a boiler heating surface overheating warning method based on multi-source data fusion and neural network model. By integrating data from multiple sources such as temperature sensors and pressure sensors, real-time monitoring of the temperature status of the boiler heating surface is achieved. At the same time, a neural network model is used to learn the warning threshold, thereby achieving accurate warning of overheating of the boiler heating surface. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of boiler heating surface overtemperature warning.

articleTitle: The simulation and implementation of high speed FPGA data acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to realize the effect of high speed data acquisition system by combining many common ADCs(Analog to Digital Converter), 13 low speed clock signals of the same frequency and different phase are produced by the high speed clock signal generated by PLL(Phase Lock Loop) in EP2C8Q208C8 FPGA(Field Programmable Gate Array), they drive 13 AD9280 of the same type to sample the analog signal source respectively at the interval of the smallest phase difference, as many as 13 times of the speed of a AD9280 can be achieved, the 400MHz data acquisition speed and data output speed can be realized. The input impedance of ADC has small effect on outcome when the output impedance of source is small and the number of ADC connected is big by calculation, the high speed of data acquisition system is affected by the maximum frequency of PLL in FPGA, the normal speed of ADC, the number of external available I/O pins of FPGA.

articleTitle: Using UDP to Realize Flexible and Portable Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the development of smart home, the research of human activity recognition (HAR) in home scene has been attracting more and more attentions in both the academic and industrial fields. Benefited from the widespread deployment of Wi-Fi routers in every household, research on Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition is cost-effective and feasible. Human activity recognition can be realized by obtaining the changes in the Wi-Fi channel state caused by human activities in the environment, and then using machine learning models for corresponding training. In this paper, a low-cost HAR system based on ESP32 is proposed, which can collect and transmit channel state information (CSI) data flexibly and efficiently by using a user datagram protocol (UDP) communication transceiver server. The proposed system avoids the use of serial port communication or SD card to collect CSI data, which reduces the difficulty of CSI data collection. An actual verification of the method is built and the performances of several common training models are compared. Our initial results show that the convolutional neural network (CNN) provide the best performances, i.e., reaching an accuracy rate of 98.6%.

articleTitle: Water level prediction using long short-term memory network with residual structure based on ensemble empirical mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To solve the problem about low accuracy of water level prediction caused by its nonlinearity and high noise, a water level prediction model based on EEMD-RESNET-LSTM is proposed. First, EEMD (Ensemble Empirical Modal Decomposition) is used for data noise reduction. Then, the RESNET-LSTM model is employed to predict the multiple components and residual term obtained after EEMD decomposition. Finally, the individual prediction results are aggregated to obtain the actual water level predictions. Compared to the three models, LSTM, RESNET-LSTM and EEMD-LSTM, the performance of this model is improved. Its RMSE is 0.127 m, MAE is 0.102 m, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> reaches 94.5% on water level prediction of Hongze Lake.

articleTitle: A 3D Multi-channel Amplifier Module with Fuzz Button in LTCC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: 3-dimensional vertical interconnection structure has become the key technology of microwave integrated package which is significant for miniaturization. Fuzz button is an elastic electrical connector which can achieve solderless vertical interconnection. In this paper, a 3D multi-channel amplifier module with fuzz button based on LTCC technology is proposed. What’s more, Wilkinson power divider is designed, and two cascaded power dividers are placed on different layers to realize miniaturization. Also, fuzz buttons and vertical transition structure from strip lines to fuzz button are designed, and fuzz buttons are used as input and output port. The test results show that in 7.8~8.2GHz, the $S_{21}$ is greater than 29 dB, the standing wave of the input port is less than 1.55 and of the output is less than 1.3.

articleTitle: CopySpell: Improving Chinese Spelling Correction Model with Copy Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The Chinese Spelling Correction (CSC) task aims to detect and correct spelling errors in texts. In recent years, BERT-based models have achieved significant breakthroughs in this field. However, CSC models still suffer from over-correction of the valid character to a similar one, which is caused by the training with downstream tasks. To solve this dilemma, we introduce CopySpell, a novel model that combines a copy mechanism with a new training method. By sharing original character information through a copy block, the model encourages robust and accurate outputs while avoiding over-correction. This approach allows the model to explore associations beyond the similar characters. Experiments are conducted on widely used benchmarks, and our model has achieved state-of-the-art results. We will also release the source code for future research and communication.

articleTitle: Privacy-preserving Data Splitting Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Privacy-preserving data splitting is an effective means of storing parts of data across different servers to safeguard user privacy. Current privacy protection schemes that employ data splitting for privacy protection assume that data owners are already aware of the constraints between attributes, which limits their applicability. To address this challenge, we propose a scheme that utilizes machine learning to segment anonymous data and securely store it. Initially, we employ machine learning algorithms to recursively compute the relationships between attributes. Subsequently, we introduce a greedy algorithm that leverages the relationships derived in the previous step to calculate a data fragmentation approach that ensures privacy safety. Experimental results indicate that our scheme can successfully derive privacy-safe fragmentation methods using various machine learning algorithms. Among the four machine learning algorithms tested, Lasso regression demonstrated the fastest computation speed.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design and simulation verification of spaceborne AIS guiding SAR imaging algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: How to quickly and effectively monitor a specific target ship in the imaging area of spaceborne SAR is a research hotspot of ocean surveillance techniques which based on the fusion of spaceborne SAR and AIS information. This paper proposes a spaceborne AIS data preprocessing algorithm for guiding SAR imaging, briefly introduces the application scenario of the algorithm, and introduces the algorithm processing flow in detail. Finally, a simulation test system is built to verify the feasibility of the algorithm processing flow. The experimental results of the simulation system show that the algorithm can assist the fast matching and searching calculation of specific target ships in the SAR imaging area, improve the SAR payload target recognition efficiency ratio, and improve the real-time data processing capability of spaceborne SAR payload.

articleTitle: ESRM: A Model for Deep Semantic Analysis of Emojis based on Prompt Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Emojis, as a way of users' emotional expression, are widely used in social scenes such as comments and communications. Due to the use of irony, borrowing, and other linguistic techniques, the shallow semantics of emojis do not reflect the real intentions expressed by users. This makes traditional models based on the shallow semantics of emoji misjudge the relationship between emoji and context, and thus make wrong predictions and classifications. To address this problem, this paper proposes an Emoji Semantic Recognition Model (ESRM) based on prompt learning. This model uses prompt learning to set up targeted prompt templates and integrate the deeper meaning features of emojis for social information recovery. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that the ESRM proposed in this paper can effectively semantically analyze social messages containing implicit expressions. The incorporation of the deep meanings of emojis makes ESRM maximize the accuracy of hidden content recovery by about 10.75%.

articleTitle: UAV Interception and Confrontation Maneuver Decision-Making Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence technology has performed outstandingly in game confrontation tasks. Based on the characteristics of UAV interception and confrontation process, this paper constructs an interception maneuver strategy learning and training environment based on reinforcement learning methods, including UAV model construction, maneuver decision-making space construction, reward and punishment signal design, enemy UAV strategy design. In order to effectively improve the exploration efficiency of the algorithm, this paper uses expert knowledge as heuristic information and proposes an improved heuristic strategy to avoid initial blind exploration while retaining the optimization ability of the greedy strategy. And completed the simulation verification under the set three-dimensional scene.

articleTitle: A multi-scale channel interactive attention network for hyperspectral image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Hyperspectral data exhibits severely uneven target sizes and subtle spectral differences, which pose deep model challenges in adaptive multiscale contextual semantic perception. In this paper, we propose a channel interaction attention model MCIAN under multi-scale spatial neighborhood perception to improve the recognition performance of multi-scale ground objects. Firstly, multiple filters with different kernel sizes extract the spatial multi-scale information of hyperspectral data in each channel group. Then, the first-order and second-order channel attention mechanisms are introduced on different scales to measure the channel importance and calibrate features from multiple perspectives. Channel grouping leads to limited information interaction between groups. Therefore, partial multiscale feature progressive channel attention recombination and concatenated fusions of other features are further introduced to perform multi-scale information interaction. Finally, the proposed attention module is embedded into a residual backbone network to achieve hyperspectral image classification. The parameter analysis, ablation experiment, and comparative analysis with the state-of-the-art deep learning methods on three public experimental data sets show that all the modules in our MCIAN have achieved the expected results, and effectively improved the classification accuracy of hyperspectral images.

articleTitle: Design and evaluation methods of multi-channel combined alarm signals under different scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The design level of alarm signals is crucial for the normal operation of automated systems. As artificial intelligence technology continues to develop, automated systems are becoming increasingly proficient in assisting people with a wide range of tasks. However, in instances where the system encounters abnormalities, it is imperative for individuals to promptly detect and respond to the situation. This necessitates the need for efficient and effective alarm signals to facilitate a smooth transition of control. The effectiveness of multi-channel combination alarm signals in various criticality scenarios is evaluated in this paper using a proposed evaluation index system. The improvement of alarm signal design is a critical consideration in tractor display interface design, as it plays a vital role in capturing the driver’s attention and conveying vital information during emergency situations. Effective alarm signals assist tractor drivers in effectively managing abnormal situations, ensuring the overall efficiency and safety of the system. Therefore, a signal design strategy suitable for different criticality scenarios is proposed, providing strong support for display interface design. The design level of the alarm signal is a crucial aspect of tractor display interfaces.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Shortest Path Planning Based on Improved D* Lite Algorithm in Large-Scale Off-Road Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Most traditional vehicle path planning algorithms which take the shortest path length as the optimization objective may not be able to generate safe and energy-efficient global paths in complex off-road environments. To address this problem, an improved D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> Lite algorithm that comprehensively considers the impact of distance and energy cost on the mobility of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) is proposed in this paper. After finding a physical model of energy consumption including distance, slope, and friction coefficient, the off-road environment is modeled as a network with nodes and weighted edges so that the D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> Lite algorithm can be applied to find the path with the minimum edge costs. Especially, the data storage structure, tie-breaking criteria, and retrieval strategy of D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> Lite are optimized to reduce search time and improve planning efficiency. Simple additive weighting is used to solve the multi-objective optimization problem and users can set different weights for optimization variables according to their preferences. The simulation results revealed that the improved D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> Lite algorithm generated a more feasible, energy-efficient, and safer route with higher computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Security: A Full-System Simulation Dynamic Taint Analysis Framework for Firmware
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Dynamic taint analysis is a common and efficient technique in program analysis. IoT devices are widespread and generally have weak protection, making them a hotspot for vulnerabilities. Although some dynamic taint analysis tools and frameworks have been proposed for IoT firmware, they all suffer from one or more issues: performance degradation, lack of generality, or being limited to user mode only. We propose a cross-platform, full-system simulation dynamic taint analysis framework for IoT firmware, Firmware Dynamic Taint Analysis Framework (FDTAF). FDTAF provides a novel Virtual Machine Introspection (VMI) combined with bit-level taint propagation at TCG layer of QEMU. Additionally, we provide analysis tools for the generated taint data flow to improve the usability of dynamic taint analysis when analyzing IoT devices. The implementation of FDTAF includes 1680 lines of C++ code, 9490 lines of C code, and 320 lines of Python code. We present a comparison of the applicability of FDTAF and DECAF in firmware analysis and validate the practicality of the analysis framework using real-world vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of DRL-based Route Planning under Limited Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The performance of the route planning module is affected by the on-board computing and storage capabilities, which are growing rapidly but are still limited by the enormous scale of sensed data that need to be stored and processed. So, aiming at the problems of resource-limited deep reinforcement learning-based route planning methods, this paper proposes an optimization method to improve computational effectiveness by using Attention Mechanism and reduce data storage by using improved Double-DQN. The results show that the proposed method enables the planning model to focus on valid sensed information and ignore irrelevant information, as well as effectively reduce the amount of vehicle agent’s experience data storage during environment exploration.

articleTitle: Target Identity Fusion Method Based on Improved DS Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Target data detected by multi-sensors often differ from each other due to different sensor performances, resulting in uncertainty of target identity information. Traditional Dempster-Shafer (DS) evidence theory may achieve counter-intuitive outcomes facing evidence conflicts caused by the uncertainty. Aiming for this, a novel target identity fusion method based on improved DS evidence theory is proposed in this paper. Specifically, the method considers the correlation between evidences and the importance of evidences integrally. First, an improved conflict measurement method based on Pearson correlation coefficient matrix is devised to measure the evidence credibility. Next the information volume of evidences is measured by Deng-entropy to indicate the evidence uncertainty. Then the credibility and uncertainty are weighted and combined to modify the basic probability assignment (BPA) of evidences. Ultimately, the modified evidences are fused by Dempster’s combination rule to acquire the final results. Through three numerical analysis examples, this paper demonstrates the superiority of the proposed method over typical previous approaches, which can effectively process evidence conflicts in multi-sensors information fusion.

articleTitle: Research on Fingerprint Recognition Algorithm Based on Minutiae Matching Pairs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel fingerprint minutiae matching structure called “matching pairs”. The matching pairs are constructed based on minutiae that conform to the translation and rotation invariance defined in ISO/IEC 19794-2:2011. The method for establishing matching pairs is simple and computationally efficient. It can partially adapt to the issue of minutiae misalignment caused by fingerprint deformation. By applying a small amount of global constraints, excellent matching results can be achieved. We compared our algorithm with a widely recognized fingerprint matching algorithm on publicly available datasets such as FVC 2000 DB2, as well as our own collected fingerprint dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm achieves higher matching accuracy and faster computation speed, providing valuable insights for research and applications in the field of fingerprint recognition.

articleTitle: Design of credibility-based PBFT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to address the issues of fairness, incentive mechanisms, and node evaluation in the process of electing consensus uplink nodes for the Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerant (PBFT) algorithm, this paper proposes a credibility-based PBFT algorithm design. The credibility assessment algorithm, is utilized as the basis for PBFT master node election, and the credibility assessment model is optimized through fuzzy analytical hierarchy process. Furthermore, an evaluation feedback, reward and punishment mechanism, as well as a time decay function, are designed to motivate the nodes and guarantee the reliability of PBFT node election. Finally, it is proven through experiments that the reputation-based PBFT algorithm can make a positive contribution to consensus efficiency and system security by electing nodes with a high reputation.

articleTitle: Enhanced Lightweight Hazardous Waste Detection Algorithm of YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming to address the issues of the existing harmful waste classification detection algorithm, such as excessive parameters, complex network structure, extensive computational requirements, and limited identification types that hinder the deployment on embedded devices, this paper proposes a lightweight target detection algorithm called MCFG-YOLO. Firstly, we introduce the MobileNetV3_Small network into the architecture of YOLOv5s to reduce complexity. The lightweight Ghost convolution is employed for efficient target feature extraction, while the C3Ghost module is constructed based on CSP structure to significantly decrease parameter count and computational cost. Moreover, we adopt the Focal-Loss EIoU loss function instead of the CIOU loss function, and replace the Hard-swish activation function in MobileNetV3_Small with the GELU activation function to improve the model performance and accuracy. Finally, experimental results on our self-made harmful garbage dataset demonstrate that our proposed algorithm achieves an average accuracy of 94.9%. Furthermore, it reduces model weight by 65.3%, computation amount by 71.7%, and number of parameters by 67.6%. These improvements indicate great potential for practical applications in hazardous waste management and environmental protection.

Author Keywords: classification and detection of hazardous waste

articleTitle: An efficient and privacy-preserving energy trading mechanism of peer-to-peer with MA-ABE and blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: For the peer-to-peer energy transaction trend, we propose an efficient and privacy-preserving access control scheme for transaction data. It is a distributed energy transaction matching method based on blockchain and ABE, which utilizes the access control features of ABE so that, unless the transaction is disputed, the seller and buyer can autonomously perform peer-to-peer matching through the access structure without relying on the help of other third-party nodes or centralized institutions. Meanwhile, with the user as the link, key generation is performed by multiple parties, including the user, attribute center and CA, and the multi-party key generation algorithm is embedded into the whole ABE algorithm process, which as a whole performs the attribution of security challenges. Partial access structure pre-encryption is supported in the process of transaction request encryption, and the encryption operation is divided into two phases of pre-encryption and encryption to deal with, which improves the overhead problem of transaction request sharing.

articleTitle: Single Symbol-Based Hybrid Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-Assisted Millimeter Wave Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Current schemes for the hybrid reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) assisted mmWave communication system select a limited number of RIS elements to connect to a single radio frequency (RF) chain. This is done to estimate the channels of the base station (BS)-mobile station (MS) and MSRIS separately. However, these schemes do not take full advantage of the reconfigurable characteristics of RIS elements, and require a large number of training symbols to achieve more accurate estimation performance. To tackle these problems, we propose a single symbol-based hybrid RIS-assisted mmWave channel estimation scheme. Firstly, we subtly exploit the dynamic programmable and reconfigurable characteristics of RIS elements based on the structure of a single RF chain, so as to obtain equivalent multi-dimensional received signals. Then, the angular parameters and path gains of multiple paths of the channel can be estimated within a single pilot symbol, using atomic norm minimization (ANM), the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), and the least square (LS) algorithms to achieve fine-grained sensing of the channel. Numerical results show that the proposed scheme achieves favorable channel estimation performance compared to existing hybrid RIS schemes within a single pilot symbol period.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm for High-Concurrency Digital Sampling Conversion Towards 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The popularity of software defined radio (SDR) compels the implementation of intricate digital signal processing algorithms on field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA). Traditional digital sampling conversion is a fundamental technique in SDR, frequently employed for processing digital intermediate frequency (IF) signals. With the advent and advancement of 6G networks, higher demands have been placed on signal bandwidth. The existing digital sampling conversion algorithms are incapable of meeting the practical requirements of signals with high bandwidth. This paper presents a digital sampling conversion algorithm tailored to the vision of 6G networks, and a comprehensive solution for high-concurrency digital sampling conversion is proposed. Through the implementation of a cascaded filter structure and its validation via mathematical modeling, it becomes evident that substantial reductions in system power consumption can be attained. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed optimized algorithm in this paper holds significant application value, is easily implementable, and fulfills the requirements of high bandwidth communication in 6G scenarios.

articleTitle: A Feasibility Study on Infrared Imaging-Based Face Antispoofing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The face recognition technology has made rapid progress in recent years, leading to the emergence of various commercial applications. However, the face, as a biometric modality, is inherently prone to leakage, forgery, and attack. Thus, the ability of face antispoofing (FAS) is crucial to a practical face recognition system and the security issue of face recognition has gradually become the focus of research for this technology. So far, many research works on FAS concentrate on designing algorithms that rely on either hand-crafted operators or deep learning models. But most of those methods are limited to a controlled circumstance – the test dataset needs to be collected under the same or at least a very similar acquisition setting. In other words, the generalization ability is limited with those works. In view of this, we in this research turn to a quite different approach: using the infrared (IR) as the imaging means and deep learning to build the algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that IR is favorable than visible light on three different multispectral face spoofing datasets that we prepare by ourselves. It is also observed that deep learning-based algorithms are performing better than traditional hand-crafted methods, with Vision Transformer being the best, in both same-dataset testing and cross-dataset testing.

articleTitle: Positioning Method for Covered Vehicles Based on Neutrino Detection and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In complex environments like underwater or underground, traditional navigation technologies face limitations due to the restricted penetration of optical and radio signals. Neutrino signals, which have extremely strong penetration capabilities, offer a new possibility. This study explores the challenges of navigation and positioning of covered vehicles and proposes a neutrino-based navigation and positioning technology to overcome the limitations of traditional navigation technologies in complex environments. This research combines reinforcement learning methods and Kalman filters, using the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm to tune the parameters of the Kalman filter to improve navigation and positioning accuracy. In the study, a Kalman filter estimation system model for vehicles in navigation signal denied environment environments was first established, then a navigation and positioning method based on neutrino detection was designed, and finally, a parameter adaptive PPO Extended Kalman Filter (PPOEKF) state estimation method was proposed. Through mathematical simulation and comparative analysis, the research results show that using reinforcement learning methods to tune the parameters of the Kalman filter can improve the accuracy of navigation and positioning, especially in complex environments.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Balancing Accuracy and Interpretability in Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Neural networks have transformed numerous domains, exhibiting unmatched performance when fitting dataset features to a single network or enhancing interpretability using distinct networks for each feature, known as Neural Additive Models (NAM). This paper presents the Grouped-NAM (GNAM) approach, aiming to find a balance between performance and interpretability by clustering features and allocating a unique network to each cluster. Our primary objective is to determine if GNAM can outperform NAM in model accuracy. Using k-means clustering for feature grouping, we evaluated GNAM to identify the ideal number of feature groups. The results highlight a discernible trade-off between accuracy and interpretability, influenced by factors such as feature significance and clarity in decision-making. The study pinpoints the optimal feature group count that outperforms NAM while preserving meaningful interpretability. These insights substantially contribute to the field of neural network modeling, emphasizing the importance of balancing performance and interpretability. GNAM presents itself as a promising framework that adeptly bridges this tradeoff.
